title: UsageImpactGroupVersion - Data API
description: Represents a collection of fields to set up the versions of Usage Impact Groups. This object is available in API version 58.0 and later.

ApprovedMeasureExtlid.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ApprovedMeasureExtlid.description: The approved Measure Category ID assigned by a regulator.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: The description of the Usage Impact Group Version.

EndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EndDate.description: The date when the validity of Usage Impact Group Version ends.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the Usage Impact Group Version is active. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the Usage Impact Group Version.

StartDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
StartDate.description: The date when the validity of Usage Impact Group Version begins.

TechResourceManualCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TechResourceManualCode.description: The code and version of the Technical Reference Manual which is the source for the values associated with this Usage Impact Group Version. This is necessary for regulatory reporting.

UsageImpactGroupId.description: The Usage Impact Group object associated with the Usage Impact Group Version. This field is a relationship field.

Version.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Version.description: The version number of the Usage Impact Group Version.
